description-meta: |
  This book has as an objective explore the limitations and possible solutions to infer the dynamics of ecological systems and compare mechanistic approaches with deep learning ones.

# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a guide to make stochastic simulations on theoretical ecological systems, with the purpose of acknowledge the limitations on the inference of mechanistic like generalized lotka-volterra or consumer resources models and compare them with scientific deep learning methods with explainability like shap or xai.
